hints.title: Recognizing Monotonic Stack
hints.text: Any question asking 'for each element, find the first element to its right that is greater/smaller' is solvable in O(N) using a Monotonic Stack.

hints.title: Stack Invariant
hints.text: Maintain a stack of indices with decreasing temperatures. When a warmer day arrives, it acts as the 'next warmer day' for everything smaller currently on top of the stack!

hints.title: Index Distance
hints.text: Pop the index prev_i. The waiting days is simply i - prev_i. Put answer[prev_i] = i - prev_i.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Monotonic decreasing stack where each index is pushed and popped at most once.

solutions.approach: Index Distance instead of Value (Monotonic Decreasing Stack)
